# ModelVault — Open AI Intelligence Directory, Battle Arena & WebGPU Engine

> ModelVault is the primary open intelligence index and live evaluation platform for over 11,468 AI models. It provides instant cloud streaming inference (<300ms), 100% offline WebGPU browser inference, side-by-side battle arenas, VRAM calculators, and verified model benchmarks.

## Core Capabilities & Features

- **11,468 Indexed AI Models**: Comprehensive catalog of open-weights, proprietary, text-generation, coding, reasoning, vision, and audio AI models.
- **Live Side-by-Side Model Arena (`/playground`)**: Compare any 2 AI models live on identical prompts with sub-300ms response streaming and community benchmark voting.
- **100% Offline Client-Side WebGPU Engine**: Run ONNX models (SmolLM2, Qwen 2.5, LaMini) 100% locally in browser VRAM with 0 network requests.
- **Solution Wizard (`/solve`)**: Real-world deployment selector matching specific use cases (coding, finance, privacy, edge mobile) with optimal AI model recommendations.
- **Free Developer Tools**:
  - VRAM Calculator (`/tools/vram-calculator`): Calculate exact GPU VRAM needed for 4-bit, 8-bit, and 16-bit quantizations.
  - Cost Calculator (`/tools/cost-calculator`): Estimate monthly API inference costs across major LLM providers.
  - Token Counter (`/tools/token-calculator`): Real-time token counter and context window checker.
  - Smart Model Finder (`/tools/model-finder`): Automated search matching budget, RAM, and task requirements.

## Primary Routes & API Endpoints

- Main Catalog: https://modelvault.space/models
- Live AI Arena: https://modelvault.space/playground
- Live Provider Telemetry: https://modelvault.space/telemetry
- Solution Wizard: https://modelvault.space/solve
- Open API Stream Route: https://modelvault.space/api/playground/stream

- DeepSeek R1 (Reasoning, 671B parameters)
- Meta Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
- Alibaba Qwen 2.5 72B / Qwen 3.6 27B
- Google Gemini 2.0 Flash
- Hugging Face SmolLM2 135M / 1.7B
- Mistral Large 2 & Codestral 22B
